content.description: A Marketing Executive (Chuyên viên Marketing) plans and runs marketing campaigns that build brand awareness and generate leads or sales, working across channels such as social media, digital ads, content, and events. They collaborate with content creators/designers, sales teams, and marketing managers, and their output includes campaign plans, content calendars, ad performance reports, and market/competitor research. The role sits at the execution level — turning a brand or manager's strategy into concrete campaigns and measurable results, rather than setting overall business direction.

vnMarket.value: Demand for marketing talent in Vietnam is rising alongside the digital economy, but the market is shifting: specialists in Data & MarTech and performance marketing are increasingly sought after, and future earning potential is tilting toward professionals with data analytics, automation, and AI-integration skills over purely traditional/creative marketing skillsets.

salary.value: Khoảng 6 – 12 triệu VNĐ/tháng cho vị trí Nhân viên/Chuyên viên Marketing (fresher thử việc: 5-6 triệu; junior 6 tháng-2 năm: 7-11 triệu; senior 3+ năm: 15-30 triệu). TP.HCM có mức trung bình cao nhất (~21,9 triệu/tháng), Hà Nội theo sau (~20,9 triệu/tháng).

demand.value: Ngành Marketing tại Việt Nam cần hơn 21.600 nhân lực mỗi năm theo dự báo của Trung tâm Dự báo Nhân lực và Thông tin Thị trường Lao động TP.HCM, với mức lương khởi điểm có thể lên tới 15 triệu VNĐ/tháng — phản ánh nhu cầu tuyển dụng cao do sự bùng nổ của các nền tảng số và cạnh tranh giữa doanh nghiệp.

similarJobs.name: Content Creator / Content Writer
similarJobs.distinction: Focuses narrowly on producing written, image, or video content rather than owning full campaign planning, channel mix, and budget.

similarJobs.name: Brand Executive
similarJobs.distinction: Focuses on brand positioning, identity, and long-term perception rather than day-to-day multi-channel campaign execution and lead generation.

similarJobs.name: Sales Executive
similarJobs.distinction: Focuses on direct customer conversations and closing deals/revenue targets, rather than generating awareness and demand through campaigns.

hardSkills.name: Digital marketing channels (SEO, SEM, social ads)
hardSkills.description: Core execution tools for reaching customers online, which is where most Vietnamese marketing budgets are shifting.

hardSkills.name: Content planning & copywriting
hardSkills.description: Needed to produce consistent campaign messaging across channels in Vietnamese (and often English).

hardSkills.name: Data analysis & reporting (Google Analytics, Excel, ad platform dashboards)
hardSkills.description: Needed to measure campaign ROI and justify budget, especially as employers now prize data-driven marketers.

hardSkills.name: Content/creative production tools (Canva, CapCut, basic design/editing)
hardSkills.description: Short-form video and visual content on platforms like TikTok are now central channels for reaching younger audiences.

hardSkills.name: Campaign & budget management
hardSkills.description: Executives must plan and execute campaigns within timeline and budget constraints set by managers.

softSkills.name: Creativity
softSkills.description: Needed to make campaigns stand out in an increasingly crowded digital content environment.

softSkills.name: Cross-functional communication
softSkills.description: Marketing executives must coordinate with sales, design, and product teams to align campaigns with business goals.

softSkills.name: Adaptability to trends
softSkills.description: Platforms, formats, and tools (e.g. AI content tools, short-form video) change quickly, requiring marketers to continuously adjust tactics.

value: AI integration in campaign creation and personalization
